summary: This YAML file defines a Docker Compose service called 'docusaurus' that builds a container from a Dockerfile in the current directory. The service exposes port 443, uses a configurable build target (defaulting to 'development'), and runs an infinite sleep command to keep the container alive.

explanations.7: The ${TARGET:-development} syntax means 'use the TARGET variable if it's set, otherwise default to the string development'. This lets you change which stage of a multi-stage Dockerfile gets built without editing this file.
explanations.9: The %%name=docusaurus%% is a template variable that will be replaced with the value of the 'name' field from line 1, making the container name match the service name.
explanations.13: The 'sleep infinity' command starts an infinite loop so the container keeps running indefinitely instead of exiting immediately after startup — useful for containers you want to interact with later.
